correction_1.withdrawn_claim: assistant finding #4 in the 2026-08-20 comparison report: 'All three MLB misses were coin flips, not confident errors. TOR@TB (0.511), WSH@TEX (0.460 home), and LAA@HOU (0.560 home) were the model's least decisive calls.'
correction_1.why_it_was_wrong: Confidence is |p - 0.5|. Ranked over the 8 registered forecasts, LAA@HOU is #1 of 8 (confidence 0.060) — the model's MOST confident call on the slate, not its least. It lost 3-18 and carries the slate's worst Brier, 0.3136.
correction_1.corrected_finding_owner_wording: MLB's mistakes included one near coin flip, one moderate direction-flip error, and its most confident side. The range was compressed overall, but the errors were not exclusively its least-confident forecasts.
correction_1.why_the_error_matters: The withdrawn version made the misses sound structurally excusable — noise around 50%. The truth is worse for the model: its single most confident registered call was its single worst forecast. Compression is still the headline finding, but it does not explain this slate's errors away.
